about: Free-form columns where the 2026-10-19 content audit (SEC4) found e-mail addresses or phone numbers in rows anon or a fresh signed-in account could read (up to 1,500 sampled rows per column; counts only). no-pii-exposure.mjs treats every column here as personal in static mode, and --live --content fails on a free-form column with contact details that is not listed. status: closed = no longer readable outside its parties; redacted = outsiders get text_redact_contact through the named readers, the raw column stays selectable; allowed = public by nature, with the reason.
